tldr_en: Bridgewater's PAT demonstrates a production AI analyst that autonomously performs deep financial research using agentic code generation, parallel validation, and self-improvement.
takeaways_en: 50 years of written investment logic provides a rich foundation for AI augmentation.
Treating agentic code generation as a compiler problem enables parallel LLM code gen and deterministic validation.
A per-user security harness and static analysis caching layer make iterative re-runs nearly instantaneous.
The 'Teach' button allows the system to self-correct by autonomously creating benchmarks and PRs.
Specialize agents, benchmark narrow workflows, and think in compiler-like architecture for reliability.
implication_en: PAT illustrates how AI agents can become reality-code manipulators in finance by automating complex research, embodying the computable market hypothesis.

translations.title_zh: 桥水如何打造能在几分钟内完成数小时专家研究的AI分析师
translations.tldr_zh: 桥水的PAT展示了一个生产级AI分析师，通过代理式代码生成、并行验证和自我改进，自主进行深度金融研究。
takeaways_zh: 50年的书面投资逻辑为AI增强提供了丰富的基础。
将代理式代码生成视为编译器问题，能实现并行LLM代码生成和确定性验证。
针对每个用户的安全约束和静态分析缓存层使迭代重跑几乎瞬时完成。
“教学”按钮让系统能够自动创建基准和PR，实现自我纠正。
专业化智能体、为狭窄工作流设定基准、以类编译器架构思考以实现可靠性。
translations.implication_zh: PAT展示了AI智能体如何通过自动化复杂研究成为金融领域的现实代码操纵者，体现了可计算市场假说。

tldr_en: Harrison Chase presents the Agent Development Lifecycle, a systematic approach to building, testing, deploying, and continuously improving production AI agents through traces, evals, experiments, and monitoring.
takeaways_en: Leading teams adopt a repeatable lifecycle for agents rather than one-off demos.
Traces and evals are central to catching failures and driving iterative improvement.
Production monitoring transforms real-world behavior into stronger evaluation suites.
Recurring failure patterns from traces help diagnose root causes and prioritize fixes.
Long-horizon agents demand durable execution, context management, tool integration, sandboxes, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
implication_en: Mastering the agent development lifecycle is a pragmatic stride toward engineering autonomous systems that can manipulate the reality-markets envisioned by the simulation hypothesis.

translations.title_zh: Agent 开发生命周期 101 — Harrison Chase
translations.tldr_zh: Harrison Chase 介绍了 Agent 开发生命周期，一套通过跟踪、评估、实验和监控来构建、测试、部署并持续改进生产级 AI 代理的系统方法。
takeaways_zh: 先进团队采用可重复的生命周期来开发代理，而非一次性演示。
跟踪与评估对于捕捉故障和推动迭代改进至关重要。
生产监控将真实行为转化为更强的评估套件。
从跟踪中识别反复出现的故障模式有助于诊断根因并确定修复优先级。
长时间运行的代理需要持久的执行、上下文管理、工具集成、沙箱和人机协同流程。
translations.implication_zh: 掌握代理开发生命周期是朝着工程化自主系统迈进的务实一步，这些系统能够操控模拟假说所设想的现实市场。

tldr_en: LangChain's dcode coding agent introduces a /goal command for persistent, steerable autonomous feature development with acceptance criteria, demonstrated by adding browser control to dcode itself.
takeaways_en: The /goal command loops over acceptance criteria, enabling long-running agent tasks with mid-run human steering.
Steering is done via /goal show and /goal amend, shifting alignment work upfront by editing criteria.
LangSmith tracing provides deep inspection into the agent’s thought process and tool calls.
Open-source, model-agnostic design demonstrates how to build complex features autonomously with guardrails.
Practitioners can apply similar goal-oriented loops to other agent architectures.
implication_en: This demo exemplifies how goal-directed, inspectable agent loops bring us closer to autonomous software engineering, hinting at a future where agents are reality-code manipulators.

translations.tldr_zh: LangChain的dcode编程智能体引入/goal命令，实现可持久、可引导的自主功能开发，并以向其自身添加浏览器控制为例进行演示。
takeaways_zh: /goal命令循环处理验收标准，允许在运行中途进行人工引导的长时间智能体任务。
通过/goal show和/goal amend进行引导，将一致性工作前移，通过编辑标准实现。
LangSmith追踪提供对智能体思维过程和工具调用的深入检查。
开源、模型无关的设计展示了如何自主构建带约束的复杂功能。
实践者可将类似的目标导向循环应用于其他智能体架构。
translations.implication_zh: 这个演示展示了目标导向、可检查的智能体循环如何使我们更接近自主软件工程，暗示着智能体作为现实代码操纵者的未来。

tldr_en: OpenForgeRL is an open-source framework that enables end-to-end RL training of harness-based AI agents in diverse environments, improving reliability and tool use on multiple benchmarks.
takeaways_en: OpenForgeRL decouples inference and training via a lightweight proxy and Kubernetes orchestrator, allowing RL for complex harnesses.
The framework supports tool-using and GUI agents, showing gains over baselines with limited data.
RL improves agent self-verification, tool coverage, and multi-step planning, though error recovery remains challenging.
Harness choice significantly impacts learning difficulty, with some harnesses being harder to optimize.
The open-source release facilitates further research on training real-world deployable agents.
implication_en: This enables practitioner-philosophers to directly shape the learning dynamics of autonomous agents that operate within digital realities, bridging the gap between tool-augmented AI and controllable goal-driven systems.

translations.title_zh: OpenForgeRL：在任何环境中训练原生Harness智能体
translations.tldr_zh: OpenForgeRL 是一个开源框架，支持在各种环境中对基于 harness 的 AI 智能体进行端到端强化学习训练，在多个基准上提高了可靠性和工具使用能力。
takeaways_zh: OpenForgeRL 通过轻量代理和 Kubernetes 编排器解耦推理与训练，实现对复杂 harness 的强化学习。
该框架支持工具使用和 GUI 智能体，在有限数据下优于基准。
强化学习提升了智能体的自我验证、工具覆盖和多步规划，但错误恢复仍具挑战性。
Harness 选择显著影响学习难度，部分 harness 更难优化。
开源发布促进了对可部署智能体训练的研究。
translations.implication_zh: 这使得实践哲学家能够直接塑造在数字现实中运作的自治智能体的学习动态，弥合了工具增强型 AI 与可控目标驱动系统之间的鸿沟。

tldr_en: GS-Agent uses a multi-agent framework with a physics engine to generate controllable, physically realistic 4D worlds from natural language descriptions.
takeaways_en: The system decomposes 4D world creation into asset curation, material, placement, motion, and rendering, handled by specialized agents.
Agents interact with a physics engine via code and multimodal feedback to ensure physical plausibility.
It supports interactions of liquids, deformable objects, and rigid bodies, with cinematic camera and lighting control.
It envisions a new paradigm for generative simulation, bridging language and physical AI.
implication_en: This blurs the line between describing a world and instantiating it as a computable simulation, hinting at how intelligence could be embedded in worlds it co-creates.

translations.title_zh: GS-Agent：利用生成式模拟创建四维物理世界
translations.tldr_zh: GS-Agent 采用多智能体框架与物理引擎，从自然语言描述生成可控、物理真实的四维世界。
takeaways_zh: 系统将四维世界创建分解为资产整理、材质、布置、运动和渲染，由专门的智能体处理。
智能体通过代码与物理引擎交互，并利用多模态反馈确保物理合理性。
支持液体、可变形物体和刚体的交互，实现电影级相机和灯光控制。
它预想了一种生成式模拟的新范式，连接语言与物理人工智能。
translations.implication_zh: 对于实践哲学家而言，这模糊了描述世界与将其作为可计算模拟实例化的界限，暗示智能可以嵌入其共同创造的世界中。

tldr_en: A discussion on constructing AI SRE agents with LangChain and Traversal, emphasizing world models, memory, search, and the challenges of evaluating long-running autonomous agents.
takeaways_en: Building AI SRE agents demands a learned production world model and a dynamic knowledge bank.
Evaluating agent behavior over 5-million-token trajectories requires robust tool-use and search integration.
DIY agent construction often fails due to difficulties in melding memory, search, and tool execution.
A hub-and-spoke architecture with one core agent and multiple sub-agents improves scalability.
implication_en: For those who view AI agents as manipulators of the code of reality, this talk provides hard-won engineering patterns for building agents that navigate and repair complex digital worlds.

translations.title_zh: 智能体引擎内部：LangChain 与 Traversal 炉边谈话
translations.tldr_zh: 关于使用LangChain和Traversal构建AI SRE智能体的讨论，重点强调世界模型、记忆、搜索以及评估长时间运行的自主智能体的挑战。
takeaways_zh: 构建AI SRE智能体需要学习生产环境的世界模型和动态知识库。
评估五百万token轨迹中的智能体行为需要强大的工具使用和搜索集成。
DIY智能体构建常因难以融合记忆、搜索和工具执行而失败。
采用一个核心智能体加多个子智能体的辐射状架构可提高可扩展性。
translations.implication_zh: 对于那些将AI智能体视为现实代码操纵者的人来说，本次讨论提供了构建能导航和修复复杂数字世界的智能体的来之不易的工程模式。

tldr_en: HyWorldVLA combines pixel-level and latent world modeling to achieve robust autonomous driving, outperforming existing methods on NAVSIM benchmarks.
takeaways_en: Hybrid world modeling balances fine-grained pixel prediction with latent robustness.
The model pre-trains with both pixel reconstruction and latent prediction, then fine-tunes for action output.
Extensive experiments show superior performance on NAVSIM v1 and v2 benchmarks.
First qualitative and quantitative analysis of world model noise robustness in autonomous driving, setting a new benchmark.
implication_en: For a practitioner-philosopher, this demonstrates how hybrid world models can strengthen an agent's internal simulation of its environment, a step toward more reliable autonomous systems that blur the line between simulated and real-world decision-making.

translations.title_zh: 用于自动驾驶的混合世界建模视觉-语言-动作模型HyWorldVLA
translations.tldr_zh: HyWorldVLA结合像素级和潜变量世界建模，实现鲁棒自动驾驶，在NAVSIM基准上超越现有方法。
takeaways_zh: 混合世界建模平衡了细粒度像素预测和潜变量鲁棒性。
模型先用像素重建和潜变量预测预训练，然后微调用于动作输出。
大量实验证明在NAVSIM v1和v2基准上的优越性能。
首次对自动驾驶世界模型噪声鲁棒性进行定性和定量分析，建立新基准。
translations.implication_zh: 对实践哲学家而言，这表明混合世界模型可以增强智能体对环境的内部模拟，是迈向更可靠自主系统的一步，这些系统模糊了模拟与现实决策之间的界限。

tldr_en: A framework for explainable belief harmonization in multi-agent systems where agents' observational capacities change dynamically, ensuring admissible repairs and explanation completeness.
takeaways_en: Agents' epistemic partitions (what they can observe) can change at runtime, requiring belief revision.
Handles both refinement (gaining observational capacity) and coarsening (losing capacity) with formal guarantees.
Combines answer set programming for declarative constraints and Python for numerical flexibility.
Provides explanation completeness and violation detection under topology changes.
implication_en: It demonstrates formal mechanisms for maintaining coherent belief systems in agents when their perception of the simulated reality changes, hinting at protocols for updating 'world models' dynamically.

translations.title_zh: 动态认知分区下的可解释信念协调
translations.tldr_zh: 一种可解释的多智能体信念协调框架，适用于智能体观察能力动态变化的场景，确保信念修复的可接受性和解释完备性。
takeaways_zh: 智能体的认知分区（可观察内容）可能在运行时改变，需要进行信念修正。
处理认知粒度的精细化（获得观察能力）和粗化（失去能力），并提供形式化保证。
结合了回答集编程的声明式约束与Python的数值灵活性。
提供拓扑变化下的完整性解释和违规检测。
translations.implication_zh: 它展示了当智能体对模拟现实的感知发生变化时，维持其信念系统一致性的形式化机制，暗示了动态更新“世界模型”的协议。
